name: Kal Kals (Sweet Curled Fritters)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Combine flour, egg, baking powder, powdered sugar, and vanilla to make a moist but not sticky dough.
Flatten teaspoon-sized balls of dough on the back of a fork (preferably with rounded tines) and roll off, forming small snail-shell-like curls.
Deep fry in hot oil (~350°F/180°C), six at a time, until golden brown.
Roll in more powdered sugar while still hot to coat.

culture.text: Kal kals are a fried sweet traditionally made during Christmas in Christian communities of India.
